sources.title: Connected Nations update: Spring 2026
sources.verified_claim: Ofcom's Spring 2026 update reports fixed broadband and mobile availability using January 2026 data and explicitly treats coverage as network-level availability; it is not an address-specific service guarantee for the sample parcels.

sources.title: Connected Nations and infrastructure reports
sources.verified_claim: Ofcom's infrastructure-report hub distinguishes current coverage reporting from forward-looking planned network deployments. Planned deployment is retained as forecast evidence and not treated as a committed parcel connection.

sources.title: Data downloads 2025
sources.verified_claim: Ofcom publishes fixed broadband, full-fibre take-up, performance and mobile-coverage datasets for year-on-year and local-authority comparisons. Aggregate datasets do not establish exact service at a sample parcel without address-level lookup.

sources.title: Check your gigabit broadband availability
sources.verified_claim: BDUK provides an official address checker using the June 2026 Open Market Review and warns that supplier plans can change and complete accuracy is not guaranteed. No parcel result is inferred without the exact address lookup.

sources.title: Digital Connectivity Infrastructure Guidance
sources.verified_claim: The adopted London Plan Guidance explains how Policy SI6 should support fibre, mobile and other digital infrastructure in new and existing development. Guidance requirements do not prove a sample parcel already has adequate capacity.

sources.title: Connected London
sources.verified_claim: Connected London describes current full-fibre, mobile, public-Wi-Fi and Underground connectivity programmes and a London connectivity map. Programme activity and estimated map coverage are not exact parcel service evidence.

sources.title: Council seeks gigabit broadband supplier for borough flats
sources.verified_claim: Havering sought fibre providers for council-owned flats through wayleave negotiations. The 2023 procurement is retained as historical delivery evidence and does not prove current service at parcel_46142.

sources.title: Apply for high speed broadband vouchers
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's High-Speed Connect scheme supported installation costs for qualifying SMEs but the page states applications are closed. Historical voucher support is not current parcel connectivity evidence.
